description: Input schema for GPT Image 2.6 Flare.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired image. For gif output, describe the subject, motion and loop.
examples: A cat wearing a tiny top hat, oil painting style
prompt.title: Prompt

images.description: Optional image(s) to edit. A mask or markup applies to the first image; the others serve as references.
images.title: Images

mask.description: Optional mask for the first image. Its transparent areas mark where to edit. Cannot be combined with markup.
mask.title: Mask

markup.description: Optional transparent PNG with circles, sketches or other annotations showing where to edit. Must match the first image's dimensions. Cannot be combined with mask.
markup.title: Markup

width.description: Output width in pixels. Must be a multiple of 16. For gif this is the frame width; leave width and height unset to let the model pick a size that fits the frame count.
width.title: Width

height.description: Output height in pixels. Must be a multiple of 16. For gif this is the frame height; leave width and height unset to let the model pick a size that fits the frame count.
height.title: Height

quality.description: Rendering quality. 'low' for drafts, 'high' for final assets, 'xhigh' and 'max' for maximum detail at higher cost. For svg, sets the reference image's quality.
quality.title: Quality

complexity.description: How much the model plans before rendering, independent of quality and at no extra cost. Lower suits focused edits; higher helps dense text and complex layouts but adds latency.
complexity.title: Complexity

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-10). svg output requires 1.
n.title: N

output_format.description: Output file format. gif (animated) and svg (vector) are for generation only, not edits.
output_format.title: Output Format

output_compression.description: Compression level for jpeg/webp (0-100). Ignored for other formats.
output_compression.title: Output Compression

frame_count.description: Number of animation frames. Used only for gif output.
frame_count.title: Frame Count

frame_duration_ms.description: Delay per animation frame in milliseconds, rounded to 10 ms. Used only for gif output.
frame_duration_ms.title: Frame Duration Ms

moderation.description: Content moderation strictness. 'auto' applies standard filtering; 'low' is less restrictive.
moderation.title: Moderation

background.description: Background transparency. 'transparent' requires png or webp output; prompt for an isolated subject. 'opaque' forces a solid background.
background.title: Background

title: AppInput
